ruleDefinitions.name: System Information Discovery Using sw_vers
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of "sw_vers" for system information discovery

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/sw\\_vers$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-buildVersion.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-productName.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-productVersion.*")))
